title: CP Trainer Big O table
description: drills/big-o.json: the data the general drills are generated from (largest complexity for a bound, up to which n a complexity fits, fits / doesn't fit).

opsPerSecond.description: Simple operations that fit in one second; the explanations show the arithmetic against it.

complexities.description: In order of growth, slowest first. maxN must not increase along the list.

id.description: Names a growth function the app knows how to evaluate.

label.description: LaTeX, without $ delimiters, e.g. O(n \log n).

maxN.description: The largest n that fits in one second. 1e18 means any n.

nValues.description: The n values drills ask about. Values too close to a threshold are skipped automatically.
